fields.name: StatusTargets
fields.evidence: Adder bg3.exe+0x1984660 allocates 0x30 bytes and zeroes the 48-byte HashSet shape (bucket pointer/count, next-id array, key array; size at +0x2C). bg3.exe+0x1982FA0 (ecl::StatusSystem, macOS writers ecl::StatusSystem::Update/ProcessStatusMachineRequest/UpdateStatusTickingOwnership) builds, per entity, a set of 0x30-byte sets: for each status pointer in that entity's status machine (+0x1F0/+0x1FC) it inserts the status's +0x20 member (ecl::Status.Target in SE Status.h) via FUN_140721030, then gets-or-adds the component on the entity and copies the set in. On the other path it walks the key array (ptr +0x20, count +0x2C, stride 8) and passes each key to FUN_141980420, which calls ecs::EntityWorld::IsEntityAlive on it - keys are EntityHandles. Live: bucket count 5, 1-2 keys.

open_questions: Exact meaning of the set: the entities targeted by statuses of this entity's status machine that are kept as a backup for ticking ownership (name inferred from the +0x20 = Target member of ecl::Status).
